| 

payment\_reversals\[\].  
**status**  
  
enum

 | 

The current status of the resource. Always PENDING or UNMATCHED on creation. For a PaymentReversal to reach a status other than UNMATCHED, a `Payment` must exist with an `id` and `scheme` value that matches `payment_id` and `scheme_id` respectively.  
  
**Enum values**  
**PAYMENT\_REVERSAL\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default PaymentReversal status.  
**PAYMENT\_REVERSAL\_STATUS\_PENDING:**  
Indicates that the PaymentReversal is matched and in progress.  
**PAYMENT\_REVERSAL\_STATUS\_COMPLETED:**  
Indicates that the associated `Payment` has been reversed.  
**PAYMENT\_REVERSAL\_STATUS\_UNMATCHED:**  
Indicates that the PaymentReversal does not match an existing `Payment`.  
**PAYMENT\_REVERSAL\_STATUS\_REQUIRES\_REVIEW:**  
Indicates that the associated `Payment` requires review.  
**PAYMENT\_REVERSAL\_STATUS\_PAYMENT\_RETURNED:**  
Indicates that the PaymentReversal could not be completed as the associated `Payment` has been returned.

 |
| 

payment\_reversals\[\].  
**payment\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the [Payment](/vault-core/5-9/EN/api/payments_hub_api#Payments) this PaymentReversal is associated with. Optional.  
  
If this field is not populated, a PaymentReversal will always have the status UNMATCHED. If an associated `Payment` exists, basic validation will be performed:  
\- The `Payment` direction must be INBOUND  
\- The `Payment` execution plan must support PaymentReversals.  
  
The associated `Payment` is only guaranteed to exist if the PaymentReversal status is not UNMATCHED. If the field is populated and the status is UNMATCHED, this can indicate that:  
\- The corresponding `Payment` with matching scheme may not exist  
\- The corresponding `Payment` has not been created or processed yet

 |
| 

payment\_reversals\[\].  
**scheme\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The [Scheme](/vault-core/5-9/EN/api/payments_hub_api#Schemes) that the PaymentReversal belongs to. The Scheme must exist for the resource to be created. Required.

 |

**PAYMENT\_REVERSAL\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN:**

**PAYMENT\_REVERSAL\_TYPE\_REVERSAL\_PRE\_SETTLEMENT:**  
A PaymentReversal that should be completed, where possible, before the movement of funds. The Payments Hub will still reverse the `Payment` if settlement has already occurred.  
**PAYMENT\_REVERSAL\_TYPE\_REVERSAL\_POST\_SETTLEMENT:**  
A PaymentReversal that should be completed after the movement of funds.

 |
| 

**status**  
  
enum

 | 

The current status of the resource. Always PENDING or UNMATCHED on creation. For a PaymentReversal to reach a status other than UNMATCHED, a `Payment` must exist with an `id` and `scheme` value that matches `payment_id` and `scheme_id` respectively.  
  
**Enum values**  
**PAYMENT\_REVERSAL\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default PaymentReversal status.  
**PAYMENT\_REVERSAL\_STATUS\_PENDING:**  
Indicates that the PaymentReversal is matched and in progress.  
**PAYMENT\_REVERSAL\_STATUS\_COMPLETED:**  
Indicates that the associated `Payment` has been reversed.  
**PAYMENT\_REVERSAL\_STATUS\_UNMATCHED:**  
Indicates that the PaymentReversal does not match an existing `Payment`.  
**PAYMENT\_REVERSAL\_STATUS\_REQUIRES\_REVIEW:**  
Indicates that the associated `Payment` requires review.  
**PAYMENT\_REVERSAL\_STATUS\_PAYMENT\_RETURNED:**  
Indicates that the PaymentReversal could not be completed as the associated `Payment` has been returned.

 |
| 

**payment\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the [Payment](/vault-core/5-9/EN/api/payments_hub_api#Payments) this PaymentReversal is associated with. Optional.  
  
If this field is not populated, a PaymentReversal will always have the status UNMATCHED. If an associated `Payment` exists, basic validation will be performed:  
\- The `Payment` direction must be INBOUND  
\- The `Payment` execution plan must support PaymentReversals.  
  
The associated `Payment` is only guaranteed to exist if the PaymentReversal status is not UNMATCHED. If the field is populated and the status is UNMATCHED, this can indicate that:  
\- The corresponding `Payment` with matching scheme may not exist  
\- The corresponding `Payment` has not been created or processed yet

 |
| 

**scheme\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The [Scheme](/vault-core/5-9/EN/api/payments_hub_api#Schemes) that the PaymentReversal belongs to. The Scheme must exist for the resource to be created. Required.

 |
| 

**create\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The timestamp indicating when the PaymentReversal was created.

 |
| 

**update\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The timestamp indicating when the last change to the PaymentReversal occurred.

 |
| 

**scheme\_reason\_code**  
  
string

 | 

The scheme code for the reason for the PaymentReversal. Optional.

 |
| 

**metadata**  
  
object

 | 

Represents scheme/gateway-specific metadata in the form of a JSON object. No validations are performed on this field. Optional.

 |

### [](#scheme "Copy link to heading")Scheme

#### [](#available_methods_9 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_payment_hub_v1_schemes_ListSchemesResponse_ListSchemes) Lists and filters Schemes.
    
-   [Create](#_payment_hub_v1_schemes_Scheme_CreateScheme) Creates a new Scheme in the Payments Hub.
    
-   [Get](#_payment_hub_v1_schemes_Scheme_GetScheme) Retrieves a Scheme based on the Scheme ID.
    
-   [Update](#_payment_hub_v1_schemes_Scheme_UpdateScheme) Updates an existing Scheme to use a new SchemeConfig or set a new status.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_payment_hub_v1_schemes_BatchGetSchemesResponse_BatchGetSchemes) Retrieves one or more Schemes based on the Scheme ID or list of Scheme IDs.
    

#### [](#_payment_hub_v1_schemes_ListSchemesResponse_ListSchemes "Copy link to heading")List

Lists and filters Schemes. Results are returned ordered by descending `update_timestamp` (most recently updated first).

**Permission Scopes:** payments\_hub:read, payments\_hub.schemes:read

**Endpoint:** GET /v1/schemes

enum

Default value.  
**SCHEME\_STATUS\_ACTIVE:**  
Once a Scheme is ACTIVE, it is possible to create [Payments](/vault-core/5-9/EN/api/payments_hub_api#Payments).  
**SCHEME\_STATUS\_INACTIVE:**

#### [](#_payment_hub_v1_uk_ValidateBBANResponse_ValidateBBAN "Copy link to heading")Validate

Validates a UK BBAN that can be external to the bank and the Payments Hub. It applies modulus checking to verify that the combination of bank identifier and account number is valid. Optionally, this validates that the supplied bank identifier is routable for a given scheme. To use this endpoint, the Extended Industry Sort Code Directory (EISCD) and Modulus Weight Table Data files must be downloaded and hosted.

**Permission Scopes:** payments\_hub:read, payments\_hub.bbans:read

**Endpoint:** POST /v1/uk/bbans:validate

##### [](#request_49 "Copy link to heading")Request

Body parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**bban**  
  
object

 | 

The BBAN to be validated. This does not need to be a BBAN resource present in the Payments Hub. It can be the BBAN representation of the routing information of any UK bank account. Required.

 |
| 

bban.  
**bank\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the bank branch the account is held in. This is also known as the sort code. Required on resource creation.

 |
| 

bban.  
**account\_number**  
  
string

 | 

The account number of the account. Optional on resource creation. If it is provided, modulus checking will be applied to verify the account number’s validity. If it is not provided, the Payments Hub will generate an account number for the provided `bank_id`.

 |
| 

**scheme**  
  
string

 | 

A scheme for which the routability of the BBAN will be checked. This can be either `FPS`, `BACS`, `CHAPS` or `ICS`. Optional.

 |

##### [](#response_49 "Copy link to heading")Response

Response fields  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**is\_valid**  
  
boolean

 | 

Indicates if the provided BBAN is valid. This will return true if the BBAN successfully passes modulus checking. Also, if requested, it will return true if the BBAN is routable via the provided scheme.

 |
| 

**reason**  
  
string

 | 

The reason why the BBAN validation succeeded or failed.

 |

#### [](#_payment_hub_v1_uk_ValidateIBANResponse_ValidateIBAN "Copy link to heading")Validate

Validates a UK IBAN that can be external to the bank and the Payments Hub. It validates the structure of the IBAN and applies the Modulo97 algorithm to catch any transcription errors. It does not validate the routability of the contained BBAN.

**Permission Scopes:** payments\_hub:read, payments\_hub.ibans:read

**Endpoint:** POST /v1/ibans:validate

##### [](#request_50 "Copy link to heading")Request

Body parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**iban**  
  
object

 | 

The IBAN to be validated. This does not need to be an IBAN resource present in the Payments Hub. It can be the IBAN representation of the routing information of any UK bank account. Required.

 |
| 

iban.  
**account\_number**  
  
string

 | 

The IBAN number of the account. Optional on resource creation. If the IBAN is provided, the Modulo97 algorithm is applied to validate the IBAN’s check digits. If the IBAN is not provided, the IBAN will be generated by the Payments Hub.

 |

##### [](#response_50 "Copy link to heading")Response

Response fields  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**is\_valid**  
  
boolean

 | 

Indicates if the provided IBAN is valid. This will return true if the IBAN successfully passes the structural validation and the Modulo97 algorithm.

 |
| 

**reason**  
  
string

 | 

The reason why the IBAN validation succeeded or failed.

 |

## [](#payments_hub_streaming_api "Copy link to heading")Payments Hub Streaming API

### [](#overview "Copy link to heading")Overview

Like Vault’s core services, the Payments Hub natively supports event sourcing. The overall state of a Payment is determined by a series of mutations on the resource. The Payments Hub Streaming API broadcasts events relating to these mutations throughout its lifecycle so you can build your own view of the Payment as required.

The Payments Hub also broadcasts events related to the creation of SchemeMessages. SchemeMessages are messages that the central infrastructure of a payment scheme may send to participating members to:

-   Inform them about events
    
-   Alert them to changes (like a change to the transaction limit)
    

These events are emitted as Kafka messages to a series of client-facing Kafka topics. Downstream services subscribing to such topics can be:

-   Data pipelines that perform Extract-Transform-Load (ETL) operations for financial reporting
    
-   Machine Learning services that perform fraud checks
    
-   Services that push customer notifications
    
-   Data warehousing modules
    

#### [](#message_formats "Copy link to heading")Message formats

The supported message formats are JSON or Google Protobuf. The required format is set when your Vault instance is configured.

#### [](#downloading_the_proto_files "Copy link to heading")Downloading the proto files

info

If you are using the Protobuf message format, download the schemas you need to integrate with our Payments Hub Streaming API.

Download download

chat\_bubble

We guarantee API backwards compatibility at the proto level but not for code generated from those protos. Due to the varying output of available proto compilers, any code that is autogenerated from our proto files is not guaranteed to be backwards compatible with code that was autogenerated from proto files delivered with a previous version of Vault (including minor versions).

PaymentUpdatedEvents were marked for deprecation in Vault 2.8 and are due for removal in Vault 6.0. `PaymentEvent`s contain the same information as the previous `PaymentUpdatedEvent`s, so you can replace all usage of the deprecated event and topic by this one. Make sure that you make all replacements before the removal of the deprecated event and topic in Vault 6.0.

`PaymentEvent` messages are emitted on the `vault.payment_hub_api.v1.payments.payment.events` topic every time a Payment is created or updated.

#### [](#paymentupdatedevent_2 "Copy link to heading")PaymentUpdatedEvent

chat\_bubble

`PaymentEvent`s replace the functionality of [PaymentUpdatedEvents](#payment_updated_event). PaymentUpdatedEvents were marked for deprecation in Vault 2.8 and are due for removal in Vault 6.0. `PaymentEvent`s contain the same information as the previous `PaymentUpdatedEvent`s, so you can replace all usage of the deprecated event and topic by this one. Make sure that you make all replacements before the removal of the deprecated event and topic in Vault 6.0.

chat\_bubble

Similarly, usage of this topic and event in the auto-instantiation of `Workflow`s is also deprecated. Make sure that any `Workflow` that depends on messages on this topic migrates to using `[PaymentEvent](#payment_event)` messages before Vault 6.0. More information on the auto-instantiation of `Workflow`s can be found in the [`Workflow` auto-instantiation reference documentation](/vault-core/5-9/EN/reference/workflows-tickets/workflow-auto-instantiations#workflow_autoinstantiation)

`PaymentUpdatedEvent`s are streamed out to notify listeners to any updates to the Payment resource. This includes the creation of new Payment resources, as well as updates to existing Payment resources. The full Payment resource is emitted in every event, regardless of the `update_mask`.

chat\_bubble

It is possible for a single API request to update multiple fields in a `Payment` resource, which will result in the streaming out of multiple `PaymentUpdatedEvent`s of different types. All events will have the same `event_id` value, hence we do not guarantee uniqueness on the value of `event_id` alone. Uniqueness is only guaranteed between both event type and `event_id.` For example, no two `PaymentUpdatedEvent`s of type `current_status_update` will share an `event_id`.

When filtering `PaymentUpdatedEvent`s, it is strongly recommended it is done on the `Update` type of `current_status_update`. This is because events with `current_status_update`s contain the most information about the lifecycle of the Payment, indicating when a `Payment` both started and finished processing, along with its final state.

If certain fields on the `Payment` resource are not populated until some point after creation in a Payment’s lifecycle, then these fields may contain no value in events sent out before the field is populated. After population, all subsequent events will contain this value. These fields are `settlement_information.settlement_date`, `settlement_information.settlement_cycle_id`, `scheme_transaction_id`, `scheme_payment_type`, `metadata`, `additional_credit_information.redirected_internal_account_id` and `additional_credit_information.redirected_party`.

*Topic*: `vault.payment_hub.payment_events.v1`

#### [](#paymentinterbanksettlementinformationupdate "Copy link to heading")PaymentInterbankSettlementInformationUpdate

`PaymentInterbankSettlementInformationUpdate` is an object indicating that the wrapping event was emitted due to the interbank settlement cycle information of the Payment being updated.

chat\_bubble

Events with `PaymentInterbankSettlementInformationUpdate` objects are replacing those with `PaymentSettlementInformationUpdate` set. During the migration period, every time an event with an `PaymentSettlementInformationUpdate` object set is emitted, an event with the same `event_id` value and a `PaymentInterbankSettlementInformationUpdate` object set will also be emitted. The contained `PaymentSettlementInformationUpdate` and `PaymentInterbankSettlementInformationUpdate` objects will have identical information.

## [](#payments_hub_dlqs "Copy link to heading")Payments Hub DLQs

### [](#files_dlqs "Copy link to heading")Files DLQs

#### [](#dlq_name_vault_payment_hub_files_file_events_regional_processors_dlq "Copy link to heading")DLQ name: vault.payment\_hub.files.file.events.regional\_processors.dlq

##### [](#what_message_has_been_sent_to_the_dlq "Copy link to heading")What message has been sent to the DLQ?

[FileEvent](/vault-core/5-9/EN/api/payments_hub_api#files_events)

##### [](#what_topic_was_the_message_originally_consumed_from "Copy link to heading")What topic was the message originally consumed from?

`vault.payment_hub_api.v1.files.file.events`

##### [](#what_failed "Copy link to heading")What failed?

A message is published to the DLQ if there was a problem applying a `File` resource change to the Payments Hub.

##### [](#what_is_the_impact "Copy link to heading")What is the impact?

The impact of this DLQ depends on which region(s) the Payments Hub is configured to use.

 
| Region | Impact |
| --- | --- |
| 
United Kingdom

 | 

Changes to the Extended Industry Sort Code Directory (EISCD) or Modulus Weight Table Data files will not be applied across the Payments Hub. As a result, payments may be validated against outdated (EISCD) or Modulus Weight Table Data entries.

 |

##### [](#possible_failure_reasons_and_recoveries "Copy link to heading")Possible failure reasons and recoveries

For any error message seen on this DLQ, please contact Thought Machine.

#### [](#dlq_name_vault_payment_hub_files_file_version_events_regional_processors_dlq "Copy link to heading")DLQ name: vault.payment\_hub.files.file\_version.events.regional\_processors.dlq

##### [](#what_message_has_been_sent_to_the_dlq_2 "Copy link to heading")What message has been sent to the DLQ?

[FileVersionEvent](/vault-core/5-9/EN/api/payments_hub_api#files_events)

##### [](#what_topic_was_the_message_originally_consumed_from_2 "Copy link to heading")What topic was the message originally consumed from?

`vault.payment_hub_api.v1.files.file_version.events`

##### [](#what_failed_2 "Copy link to heading")What failed?

A message is published to the DLQ if there was a problem validating a created `FileVersion` resource.

##### [](#what_is_the_impact_2 "Copy link to heading")What is the impact?

The `FileVersion` that was created will not be validated and cannot be used with a `File` resource.

##### [](#possible_failure_reasons_and_recoveries_2 "Copy link to heading")Possible failure reasons and recoveries

For any error message seen on this DLQ, please contact Thought Machine.

### [](#payment_dlqs "Copy link to heading")Payment DLQs

#### [](#dlq_name_vault_integrations_payments_fps_outbound_responses_dlq "Copy link to heading")DLQ name: vault.integrations.payments.fps.outbound.responses.dlq

chat\_bubble

This topic will only exist if you are using the Thought Machine Bottomline connector.

##### [](#what_message_has_been_sent_to_the_dlq_3 "Copy link to heading")What message has been sent to the DLQ?

XML representation of a [ISO20022 PACS 002.001.06](https://www.iso20022.org/standardsrepository/type/pacs.002.001.06) message.

##### [](#what_topic_was_the_message_originally_consumed_from_3 "Copy link to heading")What topic was the message originally consumed from?

One of:

-   `vault.integrations.payments.fps.outbound.sip.responses`; or
    
-   `vault.integrations.payments.fps.outbound.sop.responses`; or
    
-   `vault.integrations.payments.fps.outbound.fdp.rtn.responses`
    

##### [](#what_failed_3 "Copy link to heading")What failed?

The Thought Machine Bottomline connector publishes messages to this DLQ if there was an issue processing a response to an outbound FPS payment request.

##### [](#what_is_the_impact_3 "Copy link to heading")What is the impact?

The affected Payment will be stuck at `PAYMENT_STATUS_SUBMITTED` with the related funds remaining ringfenced.

##### [](#possible_failure_reasons_and_recoveries_3 "Copy link to heading")Possible failure reasons and recoveries

*Failure:* No such outbound FPS Payment exists in Vault for the payment referenced in the response message.

*Error message:* `unable to find Payment with FPID…​`.

*Recovery Path:* Investigate with Bottomline.

chat\_bubble

For any error message seen on this DLQ that is not given above, please contact Thought Machine.

#### [](#dlq_name_vault_integrations_payments_fps_inbound_requests_dlq "Copy link to heading")DLQ name: vault.integrations.payments.fps.inbound.requests.dlq

chat\_bubble

This topic will only exist if you are using the Thought Machine Bottomline connector.

##### [](#what_message_has_been_sent_to_the_dlq_4 "Copy link to heading")What message has been sent to the DLQ?

XML representation of a [ISO20022 PACS 008.001.05](https://www.iso20022.org/standardsrepository/type/pacs.008.001.05) message or XML representation of a [ISO20022 PACS 007.001.05](https://www.iso20022.org/standardsrepository/type/pacs.007.001.05) message.

##### [](#what_topic_was_the_message_originally_consumed_from_4 "Copy link to heading")What topic was the message originally consumed from?

One of:

-   `vault.integrations.payments.fps.inbound.fdp.rtn.requests`; or
    
-   `vault.integrations.payments.fps.inbound.sip.requests`; or
    
-   `vault.integrations.payments.fps.inbound.sop.requests`; or
    
-   `vault.integrations.payments.fps.inbound.requests.retry`
    

##### [](#what_failed_4 "Copy link to heading")What failed?

The Thought Machine Bottomline connector publishes messages to this DLQ if there was an issue processing a request for an inbound FPS payment.

##### [](#what_is_the_impact_4 "Copy link to heading")What is the impact?

A message placed on this queue will result in one of:

-   An inbound FPS payment not being processed with no Payment created in the Payments Hub. It’s unlikely that an inbound response would be generated for an inbound request that is published to this topic. In the absence of a response, it is likely that FPS would re-send the inbound request (for SOP/FDP/CBP/RTN) or send a reversal request (for SIP).
    
-   Bottomline/FPS being notified via a syntax error code that a message was received that was determined to be invalid by the Payments Hub.
    
-   A reversal request from FPS for an inbound payment not being processed, resulting in a customer incorrectly holding funds.
    

##### [](#possible_failure_reasons_and_recoveries_4 "Copy link to heading")Possible failure reasons and recoveries

*Failure:* Unexpected XML contents

*Error message:*

-   `Unrecognised xml namespace for message type`
    
-   `convert reversal request to PACS document`
    
-   `unable to convert to PACS document`
    
-   `payment schema validation`
    
-   `unable to validate payment schema`
    

*Recovery Path:* Investigate with Bottomline. For `payment schema validation` and `unable to validate payment schema` (both indicating failed XSD validation) a syntax error response will have been sent to Bottomline; in the remaining cases no response will have been sent.

*Failure:* Duplicate FPID Detected

*Error message:* `duplicate FPID identified in stand-in payment`

*Recovery Path:* Investigate with Bottomline/FPS. In this case, a special response code will have been sent to Bottomline indicating a duplicate FPID.

chat\_bubble

For any error message seen on this DLQ that is not given above, please contact Thought Machine.

#### [](#dlq_name_vault_integrations_payments_fps_inbound_standin_requests_dlq "Copy link to heading")DLQ name: vault.integrations.payments.fps.inbound.standin.requests.dlq

chat\_bubble

This topic will only exist if you are using the Thought Machine Bottomline connector.

##### [](#what_message_has_been_sent_to_the_dlq_5 "Copy link to heading")What message has been sent to the DLQ?

XML representation of a [ISO20022 PACS 008.001.05](https://www.iso20022.org/standardsrepository/type/pacs.008.001.05) message or XML representation of a [ISO20022 PACS 007.001.05](https://www.iso20022.org/standardsrepository/type/pacs.007.001.05) message.

##### [](#what_topic_was_the_message_originally_consumed_from_5 "Copy link to heading")What topic was the message originally consumed from?

`vault.integrations.payments.fps.inbound.standin.requests`

##### [](#what_failed_5 "Copy link to heading")What failed?

The Thought Machine Bottomline connector publishes messages to this DLQ if there was an issue processing an inbound FPS \`Post Stand-In' payment request.

##### [](#what_is_the_impact_5 "Copy link to heading")What is the impact?

A message placed on this queue will result in one of:

-   An inbound payment from FPS not being processed and no Payment being created in the Payments Hub. It is unlikely that an inbound response to the Post Stand-In payment would be generated for an inbound request that is published to this topic. As these messages relate to Post Stand-In payments that have already been accepted by Bottomline, it is likely that messages on this topic indicate that a customer is missing funds.
    
-   Bottomline/FPS being notified via a syntax error code that a message was received that was deemed to be invalid by the Payments Hub.
    
-   A reversal request (received whilst the bank was in Stand-In mode) from FPS for an inbound payment not being processed, resulting in a customer incorrectly holding funds.
    

The error message provides hints as to which scenario occurred.

##### [](#possible_failure_reasons_and_recoveries_5 "Copy link to heading")Possible failure reasons and recoveries

*Failure:* Unexpected XML contents

*Error message:*

-   `Unrecognised xml namespace for message type`
    
-   `convert reversal request to PACS document`
    
-   `unable to convert to PACS document`
    
-   `payment schema validation`
    
-   `unable to validate payment schema`
    

*Recovery Path:* Investigate with Bottomline. For `payment schema validation` and `unable to validate payment schema` (both indicating failed XSD validation) a syntax error response will have been sent to Bottomline; in the remaining cases no response will have been sent.

*Failure:* Duplicate FPID Detected

*Error message:* `duplicate FPID identified in stand-in payment`

*Recovery Path:* Investigate with Bottomline/FPS. In this case, a special response code will have been sent to Bottomline indicating a duplicate FPID.

chat\_bubble

For any error message seen on this DLQ that is not given above, please contact Thought Machine.

#### [](#dlq_name_vault_integrations_payments_fps_inbound_usm_dlq "Copy link to heading")DLQ name: vault.integrations.payments.fps.inbound.usm.dlq

chat\_bubble

This topic will only exist if you are using the Thought Machine Bottomline connector.

##### [](#what_message_has_been_sent_to_the_dlq_6 "Copy link to heading")What message has been sent to the DLQ?

XML files of varying schemas. Please see the Bottomline documentation for a full list of supported USM files.

##### [](#what_topic_was_the_message_originally_consumed_from_6 "Copy link to heading")What topic was the message originally consumed from?

`vault.integrations.payments.fps.inbound.usm`

##### [](#what_failed_6 "Copy link to heading")What failed?

The Thought Machine Bottomline connector publishes messages to this DLQ if there was an issue processing an FPS USM message received from Bottomline.

##### [](#what_is_the_impact_6 "Copy link to heading")What is the impact?

The Scheme Message resource will not be created in Vault, and will not be visible in the Scheme Messages Ledger. Any implemented downstream processes that depend on Scheme Messages being created to display received USM messages will not be triggered.

#### [](#dlq_name_vault_payment_hub_payment_events_bottomline_v1_dlq "Copy link to heading")DLQ name: vault.payment\_hub.payment\_events.bottomline.v1.dlq

error

This DLQ has been deprecated in release version 2.8 and will be removed no earlier than version 4.0. It has been replaced by `vault.payment_hub_api.v1.payments.payment.events.bottomline.dlq`.

chat\_bubble

This topic will only exist if you are using the Thought Machine Bottomline connector.

##### [](#what_message_has_been_sent_to_the_dlq_7 "Copy link to heading")What message has been sent to the DLQ?

[PaymentUpdatedEvent](/vault-core/5-9/EN/api/payments_hub_api#payment_events).

##### [](#what_topic_was_the_message_originally_consumed_from_7 "Copy link to heading")What topic was the message originally consumed from?

`vault.payment_hub.payment_events.v1`

##### [](#what_failed_7 "Copy link to heading")What failed?

The Thought Machine Bottomline connector publishes messages to this DLQ if there was an issue processing a `Payment` event produced by the Payments Hub.

##### [](#what_is_the_impact_7 "Copy link to heading")What is the impact?

A message placed on this queue will result in one of the following impacts, depending on the `direction` of the Payment:

-   Outbound FPS Payments will not be submitted to the scheme, and will become stuck in a `current_status` of `PAYMENT_STATUS_SUBMITTED` and the associated funds will remain in an authorised state.
    
-   Inbound FPS Payments will not have their responses returned to the scheme. The associated `Payment` resources will continue to reach their final statuses, and financial movements will be correct, but the outcomes will not be returned to the scheme or receiving bank. This may lead to the reversal of synchronous inbound payments or the re-sending of asynchronous payment types (SOP/FDP/RTN/CBP).
    

##### [](#possible_failure_reasons_and_recoveries_7 "Copy link to heading")Possible failure reasons and recoveries

For any error message seen on this DLQ, please contact Thought Machine.

#### [](#dlq_name_vault_payment_hub_api_v1_payments_payment_events_credit_transfer_reversal_processor_dlq "Copy link to heading")DLQ name: vault.payment\_hub\_api.v1.payments.payment.events.credit\_transfer\_reversal\_processor.dlq

##### [](#what_message_has_been_sent_to_the_dlq_14 "Copy link to heading")What message has been sent to the DLQ?

[PaymentEvent](/vault-core/5-9/EN/api/payments_hub_api#payment_events).

##### [](#what_topic_was_the_message_originally_consumed_from_14 "Copy link to heading")What topic was the message originally consumed from?

`vault.payment_hub_api.v1.payments.payment.events`

##### [](#what_failed_14 "Copy link to heading")What failed?

When attempting to update a Payment Reversal’s status as a consequence of the creation or update of the corresponding Payment, the Payment event signalling the change is published to this DLQ if an unexpected error arises.

##### [](#what_is_the_impact_14 "Copy link to heading")What is the impact?

The `status` of the Payment Reversal will not be updated to reflect the current status of the Payment. It will still be possible to check the status of the Payment Reversal by inspecting the Payment. There will be no impact to the processing of the Payment Reversal. If subsequent events are successfully processed for the Payment being reversed, the Payment Reversal’s `status` will be updated correctly.

For any error message seen on this DLQ, please contact Thought Machine.

##### [](#what_failed_24 "Copy link to heading")What failed?

The OnUs Processor or FPS Processor will publish messages to this DLQ if they fail to process a Scheme Event indicating a change to a Scheme resource.

##### [](#what_is_the_impact_24 "Copy link to heading")What is the impact?

A Scheme Resource update cannot be correctly registered by one of the scheme processors. The affected processor may then not be able to perform accurate scheme validation resulting in some outbound payments being incorrectly validated (and so submitted) or invalidated (and so cancelled).

### [](#schemes_dlqs "Copy link to heading")Schemes DLQs

#### [](#dlq_name_vault_payment_hub_schemes_scheme_events_scheme_processors_dlq_2 "Copy link to heading")DLQ name: vault.payment\_hub.schemes.scheme.events.scheme\_processors.dlq

##### [](#what_message_has_been_sent_to_the_dlq_25 "Copy link to heading")What message has been sent to the DLQ?

[SchemeEvent](/vault-core/5-9/EN/api/payments_hub_api#schemes_events)

##### [](#what_topic_was_the_message_originally_consumed_from_25 "Copy link to heading")What topic was the message originally consumed from?

`vault.payment_hub_api.v1.schemes.scheme.events`

##### [](#what_failed_25 "Copy link to heading")What failed?

A message is published to the DLQ if there was a problem applying a `Scheme` resource change to the Payments Hub

##### [](#what_is_the_impact_25 "Copy link to heading")What is the impact?

New `SchemeConfig` resource or `CalendarOperationConfig` resource values will not be applied by the Payments Hub. This may cause payments to be validated against an outdated `SchemeConfig`, or for future payments or standing orders to be enriched with an outdated `CalendarOperationConfig`.

##### [](#possible_failure_reasons_and_recoveries_25 "Copy link to heading")Possible failure reasons and recoveries

For any error message seen on this DLQ, please contact Thought Machine
